digest.component_or_area: LLM model class system and configuration
propositions: Single scalar REBAR_LLM_MODEL cannot express per-tier model mapping across multiple passes, causing silent fallback-chain loss and cross-provider split-brain routing
Configuration layering via REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE must deep-merge table values and replace array values wholesale to allow environment overrides of individual keys without restatement

Class names reserved as values in existing step model/model_ladder fields resolve through resolve_model_string at three independent call sites (config.resolve_model, batch runner ladder expansion, verifier paths) to avoid module-level import cycles

Per-pass model selection correctly routes through distinct providers when classes are configured with different providers, verified by operator attestation of dual-provider gate run with 41 frontier calls and 1 standard call across providers
